_readme: Real proof only. Everything here is optional and nothing shows until it's filled in. reelsMade: used until the live counter is connected. cohort: e.g. "42 creators in the launch preview". avatars: early users' photos (with their permission), e.g. "site/img/u1.jpg". quotes: { name (first name), role (e.g. "fitness creator", "podcast host"), photo, text (one line with a specific outcome) }. mentions: { name, link, date }.
